focus: Semail ophiolite sections (Moho transition, sheeted dykes, pillow lavas, peridotite carbonation at Wadi Jizzi / Fizh / Sumail), Jebel Akhdar and Saih Hatat, Wahiba/Sharqiya Sands, Huqf outcrops, Dhofar karst and escarpment, Musandam drowned coast; archaeology of Al Buraimi (Hafit, Umm an-Nar, Iron Age oasis sites), North Al Batinah (Sohar, Wadi Jizzi copper smelting, Bronze Age settlements), Ad Dhahirah (beyond Bat/Al-Khutm/Al-Ayn, which are already mapped) and Musandam.
